unitAssumption: 1 world unit ≈ 1 metre (CELL=4 m tiles, playable y ∈ [0.65, 7.1])

measured.buoyancyModel: BCD state −1..+1 via Space/Q; player-set trim bias with [ ] / X; look-kick Y attenuated

notes: Ambient pressure ≈ 1 + depth_m/10 ATA; gas use scales roughly with ATA.
Neutral buoyancy + BCD control dominate vertical motion; divers do not fly with equal XYZ thrust.
Water drag is roughly quadratic; free coast after stopping kick is short.

verdicts.swimSpeed: GAMEPLAY PACE — force model cruise ~2.2 m/s / sprint ~3.5 m/s (force model retained; closer to old arcade feel).
verdicts.gasModel: SAC × ATA × EFFORT — high-stakes; main 100 L + pony 9 L at 18 L/min cruise SAC; HUD shows litres.
verdicts.buoyancy: BCD SKILL — Space/Q momentary; [ ] lock idle bias (±0.45); X clears; look-kick Y attenuated.
verdicts.dragCoast: QUADRATIC — −k|v|v; short coast after releasing kick.
verdicts.depthScale: SHALLOW CAVE — ~6.5 m playable y band; torch murk is stylistic, not optical attenuation law.
verdicts.depthHud: HYDROSTATIC — DEPTH = round(SURFACE_Y − y); −Z no longer fakes metres.
verdicts.predatorPacing: DESIGNED CHASE — chase 2.7 m/s between cruise and sprint.
verdicts.outOfScope: Currents / surge, weight belt, and real deco are out of scope for this short First Dive mission.
verdicts.overall: Gameplay-first survival with paced force locomotion; gas scales with depth and effort.
